critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2199 lines - should be split into routers (auth, admin, integrations, training, chat) for maintainability.
log_audit() is fire-and-forget with `await`; failures inside logging currently propagate — consider try/except so a logging bug never breaks a legitimate API response.

Impersonation token has no separate short TTL from regular tokens (both use make_token). Per the SaaS threat model an impersonation token should expire much sooner (e.g., 15-30 min) — currently indistinguishable from a normal login by expiry.
GET /api/me/integrations decrypts every secret on every list call just to mask; consider storing a masked_hint at write time to avoid unnecessary Fernet ops on hot path.

Frontend Dashboard.jsx is 1073 lines with 5+ inline sub-components (DashboardHome, KnowledgeBase, SettingsPanel, TrainingCenter, IntegrationsHub) - should be extracted for readability and code-splitting.
